name: Flying buttress
_about: A FLYING BUTTRESS: the pier outside the aisle, its pinnacle, and the flyer that springs from it across the aisle roof to the clerestory wall, where the nave vault pushes out -- a strut on a rampant arch (`flyer`). Placed with the pier at the origin and the flyer reaching along +x; the cathedral places one per bay down each flank and a ring of them round the apse.
